bugs.title: Login accepts any token
bugs.description: The login handler never compares the supplied token with the stored one, so any request is treated as signed in. Fix the comparison.

bugs.title: Stale note in an unmapped folder
bugs.description: A tool outside the model misbehaves.

bugs.title: Order query has no timeout
bugs.description: The order query can hang the request when the database stalls, and nothing retries it.

findings.issue: The database migration step runs outside a transaction, so a failure leaves the schema half applied.
Request handling keeps per-user state in a module-level cache.
findings.resolution: Move the state into a shared store.

findings.issue: Off-by-one in the pagination loop; rename the variable for style.
The operator guide describes a queue that the code does not have.

findings: src/auth/login.js:30-41 - [high] session tokens never expire, so a stolen token works forever
